it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 23/07/2025, em sessão solene da Câmara Municipal, quando Zé Fernando oficializou a renúncia ao cargo para se dedicar à pré-candidatura a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on July 23, 2025, in a formal session of the City Council, when Mayor Zé Fernando made official his resignation to prepare to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
